title: Pullback realization for the same normalized section scalar models
statement: For every morphism a of commutative condensed rings and scheme morphism f:X→Y, fix normalized ScalarSectionData cX and cY and an internal scalar/pullback isomorphism lam satisfying PullNormalized. There is a section scalar/pullback isomorphism barLam satisfying both PullSectionCondition and SectionPullNormalized of [def-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-data], using those same models. The ordinary comparison is the conjugate of the actual inverse pullIso, and the derived comparison is fixed by the model counits on every complex.

theorem section_pull_transport {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y)
    (hcX : ScalarSectionNormalized a X cX) (hcY : ScalarSectionNormalized a Y cY)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X) (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam) :
    ∃ barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅ derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T,
      PullSectionCondition a f cX cY lam barLam ∧
        SectionPullNormalized a f cX cY barLam
